title: Prevent synthetic noise leakage, W4 upper-limit leakage, and optimistic Gaia RVS binary clearance
what_happened: An adversarial audit identified four pipeline weaknesses: (1) generic_outlier injected random Gaussian noise when lightcurves/spectra/vanishing_data were absent, producing phantom open holes and retaining metal-poor halo subdwarf Gaia DR3 1111149103659931264 at Tier C; (2) live sample ingest allowed W4='U' upper limits (w4mpro_error IS NULL) to flood ir_excess flags; (3) _row_to_star_dict compared unpropagated 2016 Gaia vs 2010 WISE coords (0.58 arcsec drift); and (4) Gaia DR3 radial_velocity_error (median uncertainty) was treated as epoch scatter on faint rv_method_used=2 stars without rv_chisq_pvalue.
generic_lesson: Use deterministic 0.0 for absent modalities in generic_outlier, run metallicity/evolved checks on all generic_outlier stars, require w4mpro_error IS NOT NULL in live excess searches, propagate proper motion before centroid offsets, and convert median RV uncertainty via sqrt(2N/pi) (marking faint unconstrained Gaia RVS stars as binary=not_evaluated).
